_comment: Payload SHAPE for the MandiPrice publish benchmark.
The generator does not understand these fields. It substitutes
placeholders and repeats the resource block once per MARKET-COMMODITY
PAIR, so changing the shape here needs no code change.
One resource is one market and ONE commodity. That is what keeps every
resource the same size -- and so every discover response of the same
match count the same size, which is the point.
{{MARKET_ID}} {{MARKET_NAME}}          real market, from the source data
{{COMMODITY_CODE}} {{COMMODITY_NAME}}  the one commodity this resource is
{{AGM_STATE_CODE}} {{AGM_DISTRICT_CODE}}  the codes a provider call needs

descriptor.name: {{STATE_NAME}} mandi prices
descriptor.shortDesc: On-demand commodity price information for agricultural markets in {{STATE_NAME}}.
descriptor.longDesc: Each Resource represents one commodity traded at one market. Consumers discover by location or commodity and invoke the Provider to obtain current prices as a Direct MandiPrice Resource.

descriptor.name: Agmarknet Vistaar
descriptor.shortDesc: Provider of live agricultural market price information.

descriptor.name: {{COMMODITY_NAME}} prices at {{MARKET_NAME}}
descriptor.longDesc: Invoke this Resource with an applicable date to obtain minimum, maximum, and modal {{COMMODITY_NAME}} prices for {{MARKET_NAME}}. The result uses the same MandiPrice type in Direct information mode.
